rules.statement: The Supreme Court has the power to amend a decree that is not in conformity with the judgment, either under Section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code or by virtue of its inherent powers.
rules.supporting_quote: "When an error of that kind has been committed, it is always within the competency of the Court, if nothing has intervened which would render it inexpedient or inequitable to do so, to correct the record in order to bring it into harmony with the order which the Judge obviously meant to pronounce."

meta.parties: Paul, E. De Costa and Sons v. Gunaratne
